name: ask_ai_agent
reason: Non-streaming AI path (one Ask RPC, tokens coalesced). The AI screen streams through `chat_agent`; this stays as the headless/*library* form of the same request (it also carries the `inject_context` unit tests). Wire it if a screen ever wants a single-shot answer.

name: simulate_button
reason: Developer/test seam for the hardware-button path (`buttons.rs` doc: "lets desktop dev / tests drive the same path"). No screen simulates a physical key.

name: wm_home
reason: Multi-window host; `WindowManager::home()` works and is unit-tested (`amos-wm` `home_focuses_launcher`), but no frontend surface asks for it, because every "go home" the user can perform already has a live path: the touch shell's home pill / back / hardware key is `shellState.goHome()`; the desktop's Show Desktop drives `wm_windows`/`wm_hide`/`wm_focus` directly (REQ-A415); and the Launcher regains focus on its own through `promote_fallback_after` when the last app window closes or hides. Kept registered as a host capability without a consumer (docs/multi-window.md §1); REQ-A1133 audited it and found no defect to fix.

name: clipboard_guest_status
reason: Diagnostic counter snapshot for the host↔guest clipboard link. The guest agent + real socket/vsock channel are device work (docs/clipboard-container-sync.md P2/P3); nothing in the shell consumes the counters yet.

name: store_get
reason: Single-key read of the Rust shared store. Boot hydration pulls the whole snapshot (`store_snapshot`) and every other read goes through localStorage, so no caller needs one key.

name: store_remove
reason: Removal half of the shared store. No screen removes a whole key today (every action writes a new value); the command stays so the cross-window `{value:null}` removal path in `svelte/store.ts` has a symmetric producer.

name: media_read_range
reason: Bounded-window read for large media (the streaming counterpart of `media_load`, docs/media-player.md). **Corrected in REQ-A604**: the reason used to say 'the player resolves tracks with `media_load` today; range reads are the custom-protocol/streaming path (device work)' — both halves are now false. The player no longer resolves a whole item above `MAX_PLAY_BYTES`: it asks the host for an `amos-media://` URL (`media_stream_url`) and the registered protocol serves bounded `206` windows, so the streaming path a screen actually uses is the **protocol**, not this command. What stays true is that no JS caller wants windows directly: this is the JS-facing windowed read (a waveform/inspector, or a partial preview in Files), gated by the same read grant and the same error strings as `media_load`.

name: interpret_restart
reason: Reset an ended session for reuse. The screen starts a fresh session instead (`interpret_start` replaces the active one), so a restart affordance is not needed yet.

name: interpret_abort
reason: Hard-end + clear the session. `interpret_stop` (wired) ends it gracefully and the next `interpret_start` replaces it, so no screen aborts.

name: interpret_status
reason: Read back the daemon-side session state. The screen keeps its own session id/state and starts fresh on mount, so nothing adopts a live session yet.

name: mail_inbox
reason: Deliberate convenience alias of `mail_list` for the selected mailbox (recorded in docs/unwired-exports-audit.md); `MailApp` lists through `mail_list`.

name: sensor_host_set_mode
reason: In-process sensor-host developer seam (`sensor_host.rs`): drives the host-side simulator/energy mode. The Settings card reads the daemon's `sensor_*` snapshot instead (docs/sensors.md).

name: sensor_host_record_imu
reason: Developer seam: feeds a synthetic IMU sample into the in-process sensor host (host/dev + tests).

name: sensor_host_record_frame
reason: Developer seam: feeds a synthetic camera frame into the in-process sensor host (host/dev + tests).

name: sensor_host_record_vitals
reason: Wellness producer seam (REQ-A1454): the step-counter / heart-rate samples are pushed by the on-device Kotlin glue (`SensorGlue.recordVitals`, the `(JFF)V` JNI upcall in android_glue.rs), exactly as `sensor_host_record_imu` is fed by the IMU half. The Health app *reads* the bus (`sensor_host_snapshot.vitals` + the `sensor-data` event), so there is no screen-side caller — the producer is the device, not the UI.

name: sensor_host_acquire
reason: The in-process host's stream gate. Recorded in docs/unwired-exports-audit.md Round 10: exposing it would ask a *different* manager than the one producing the Settings card's stream.

name: sensor_host_record_video
reason: Registered host API with no producer **yet**: the command pushes one finished clip's *metadata* (never the bytes) into the in-process sensor host, and `SensorHostSnapshot.video_clips` already surfaces the list (REQ-A409's video half). It was declared `#[tauri::command]` but missing from `generate_handler!`, i.e. unreachable — the wiring is now in, and what is missing is the *caller*: the clip is produced by the Android/WebView `MediaRecorder` through the glue, and that glue does not exist yet. Recorded here so the gate reads the truth (a reachable API with no producer) instead of the defect (a command nothing could ever invoke).

name: perm_granted
reason: Per-app grant list from the daemon authority. The privacy dashboard reviews with `perm_grants_all` (one round-trip for every app) and gates with `perm_authorize`, so the per-app call has no consumer.

name: podcast_download_state
reason: Single-episode download read. `PodcastsApp` gets every episode's `DownloadState` inside `podcast_feed`'s `EpisodeView.download`, and `doToggleDownload` re-reads that whole feed after a queue/forget, so no screen asks for one row on its own. Kept registered (the bridge method is unit-tested) as the seam a live per-row progress poll would use — the state is `Downloading { received, total }`, which only a poll can show advancing between feed snapshots.
